activities.name: Kobie Fuller
activities.subject: Circularo - Trust Infrastructure for the Agentic AI Era
activities.body:
Hi Kobie,

I’m the co-founder and CEO of circularo.com, a profitable, bootstrapped digital trust platform headquartered in Dubai.

We’ve grown to ~$3M in recurring revenue with no external capital, building sovereign-scale digital signature and trusted transaction infrastructure used across UAE government and major enterprise environments.

We’re now extending that foundation toward trusted execution for the agentic AI era — connecting identity, authority, approvals and verifiable evidence for actions taken by humans and AI agents.

Given your focus on AI and software at Upfront, I thought our story might be relevant. I’ll be in LA from October 8 for a week and would be happy to meet in person if useful.

Best,
Josef
